title: ReviewPilot Benchmark PR Test Cases
description: Schema for the evaluation/prs.json benchmark dataset. Each entry describes a real-world GitHub Pull Request used to evaluate ReviewPilot review quality.

cases.description: List of PR benchmark test cases.

id.description: Unique, stable identifier for the test case (kebab-case). Used to name result files.

pullRequest.description: Pull Request number on the repository.

category.description: Primary nature of the change under review.

changedFiles.description: Number of files changed in the PR (used for sizing / concurrency analysis).

expectedDifficulty.description: Expected difficulty for an AI reviewer to produce useful findings.

notes.description: Human context: what the PR does, known issues the reviewer SHOULD catch, and traps that could induce hallucinations.

languages.description: Optional: primary languages present in the diff.

knownIssues.description: Optional ground truth: issues a good reviewer is expected to find. Used to score Missing Findings.

file.description: Path of the file containing the issue.

line.description: Approximate line number of the issue (post-change).

severity.description: Expected severity, aligned with the ReviewSeverity domain enum.

description.description: Short description of the expected finding.
